note: Recognition rules and fingerprints for ARRI's free look packages. Names, sizes, LUT sizes and SHA-256 only; never LUT data. Filled by tools/looks/fingerprint.py in M3-09 (HUMAN M3-H2). See docs/08-looks.md.
patterns_note: Checked on 2026-10-15 against the text of ARRI's Look Files page (https://www.arri.com/en/learn/camera-systems/image-science/look-files, pasted by Mykyta) and ARRI's five public downloads from it (unzipped and listed, names only): the three 3D-LUT packages below and the two camera look-file packages. The 3D-LUT zips each hold ONE top folder named for the package and 87 flat .cube files named '<look code> <title>.cube' ('1110 Black and White.cube'; '3250-Cross.cube' with hyphens in the LogC3 to Rec709 one): no group folders, no encoding word in the file names (the zip and folder names carry it: 'LogC4', 'LogC3', 'to Rec709'), the group is the first digit of the look code, the LUT size is 65 (LogC4) or 33 (LogC3). The LogC3 to Rec709 zip also holds a __MACOSX tree of ._ files named .cube that are not LUTs. The camera look-file zips hold .alf4 (LogC4) or .aml (LogC3, three strengths per look) files in group folders; Yellowmoon cannot read them and says which 3D-LUT download to take. The page names the downloads 'Look Library for LogC4 (3D-LUTs)' (log-to-log, 2025-07-30), 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (3D-LUTs)' (log-to-log, 2024-11-28), 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (to Rec709) 3D-LUTs' (33 mesh points, 2024-03-12), 'Look Library for LogC4 (ALF4 Look Files)' and 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (Look Files)' (2023-02-10); it states no download sizes and no LUT size for the LogC3 log-to-log library, so neither is a rule (download_mb is a hint; that library's lut_sizes is empty although its files have 33 points). The two display LUT packages are on ARRI's Technical Downloads page, not on that page; their names ('LogC4 LUT Package'), counts and file naming (ARRI_LogC4-to-Gamma24_Rec709-D65_v1_65.cube) come from ARRI's LUT naming guideline and were not checked against a download. The fingerprints of the three 3D-LUT packages were taken by the agent with tools/looks/fingerprint.py on 2026-10-15 from those downloads, with Mykyta's go-ahead (M3-H2): names, sizes, LUT sizes and SHA-256, no LUT data. How the patterns are used when a file is not in a fingerprint list: the zip_name patterns (on the zip's name or on the folder every file sits in), the encoding and the LUT sizes identify a package as a whole (at least half of expected.cube_files files); group_folders (a four-digit group folder or a look code at the start of the file name) and display_rendering are only read for files whose names say nothing about the package, and then between packages that both fit. Counts are expected values, not gates: more files than expected are imported with a note, fewer are reported as an incomplete download. Download sizes are not used to recognise anything.
